app_store.store_description_en:
Animal Puzzle Fun is a calm, hands-on jigsaw adventure for children ages 6–8. Explore 100 original animal scenes: begin with clear 3×3 boards, then meet more satisfying challenges as you go. Tap or drag each piece into place, reveal the scene, and add an animal friend to the collection.

Made for focused, low-pressure play:
• 100 original animal scenes
• Big pieces and a gentle difficulty curve
• Tap or drag controls
• A preview when a child needs a closer look
• No ads, accounts, timers, or penalties

Levels 1–20 are free. A single parent-approved purchase gives access to levels 21–100; later levels still open one at a time as children play. Purchases can be restored in the Parent Area.
